causes.label: demand
causes.quote: Temperatures in Sydney exceeded 30 degrees for the fourth consecutive day, which saw demand reach 11 519 MW at 3.30 pm. Actual demand was more than 500 MW higher than forecast.

causes.label: unscheduled_plant_outage
causes.quote: Early in the afternoon, TRUenergy reduced the available capacity of one of its Mount Piper units by 400 MW due to technical issues.

causes.label: network_outage
causes.quote: A planned outage of the South Sydney to Dapto 330 kV line commenced in the early hours of the morning.

causes.label: rebids
causes.quote: When Macquarie Generation rebid 500 MW of available capacity at Bayswater and Liddell close to the price cap, the dispatch price reached the price cap for two dispatch intervals, resulting in the spot price reaching $6498/MWh for the 3.30 pm trading interval.

constraints_named.quote: a constraint used to manage the planned outage of the Dapto to Sydney South 330 kV line (which runs between the Snowy Hydro generators at the Tumut stations and Sydney) was limiting imports into New South Wales from Victoria and constraining off generation at Upper Tumut and Uranquinty.
The reasons given were "1445A Constraint Management N>>N-DTSS_20_SL".

interconnectors_named.name: Vic-NSW
interconnectors_named.quote: This caused the constraint managing the planned network outage to bind, reducing flows from Victoria and constraining off generation at Uranquinty and Upper Tumut.

network_outages.quote: A planned outage of the South Sydney to Dapto 330 kV line commenced in the early hours of the morning.
